analysis.one_line_summary: Feature comparison chart positioning the WavyTalk Blowout Boost thermal brush against round brushes, hot air brushes, curling irons, and flat irons.
analysis.full_description: A clean, graphic product comparison chart graphic. The top portion shows a close-up studio shot of the pink/rose-gold barrel of the WavyTalk Blowout Boost thermal round brush with its ceramic perforated barrel, black bristles, and blue ION light indicator. Below is a structured comparison table comparing 'Blowout Boost' (highlighted in a green pill button) against 'Round Brush', 'Hot Air Brush', 'Curling Iron', and 'Flat Iron'. The features compared across four rows are Multi-Styling, Minimal Skill, Gentle Heat, and Silent, showing that only the Blowout Boost checks all four boxes.

on_screen_text.text: Blowout Boost | Round Brush | Hot Air Brush | Curling Iron | Flat Iron

scenes.visual: A white background static ad featuring a vertical studio render of the WavyTalk Blowout Boost thermal barrel at top and a comparative feature table below with checkmarks and crosses.
scenes.action: Static image display showing the Blowout Boost winning across all evaluated criteria (multi-styling, minimal skill, gentle heat, silent).

narrative_beats: Show the product barrel and technology indicator
Compare Blowout Boost against 4 traditional hair styling tools across 4 pain points / criteria
Demonstrate that Blowout Boost is the only tool with checkmarks across all features
key_claims: Completely silent operation (thermal brush without noisy motor/fan)
pain_points: Round brushes require high skill and two hands with a hair dryer
Hot air brushes are loud, noisy, and difficult to manage
Curling irons and flat irons cause high heat damage and lack multi-styling versatility
objections_handled: Is it hard to use? (Addressed: Minimal Skill required)
Does it burn hair? (Addressed: Gentle Heat)
Is it loud like blow dryer brushes? (Addressed: Silent)
structure.comparison_to: Traditional round brush, hot air brush / blow dryer brush, curling iron, flat iron / straightener
